# Inkscape MCP: operational guide for agents

The running server's MCP `tools/list` schema is authoritative. Reconnect after
code updates. Do not send undocumented kwargs or an injected FastMCP Context.
The complete operation and parameter reference is [docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md).

## Setup

- Source: https://github.com/GianluDeveloper/inkscape-mcp
- Entry point: `uv run inkscape-mcp --mode stdio`.
- Requirements: Python 3.12+, uv, Inkscape CLI. Native GUI bridge: Linux, Inkscape
  1.3+, gdbus, installed native effect, access to the user's desktop session.
- Tested development host: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, Python 3.12.14, Inkscape 1.4.4.
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) includes GTK/Cairo/PyGObject build dependencies.
- Run `inkscape_system` / `status`; inspect `data.inkscape.available`, not just
  the success of the status request.

Transport defaults to stdio. Explicit CLI options override the environment.
For the optional browser dashboard:

```bash
uv run inkscape-mcp --mode http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 11028
```

In `web_sota/`, use Bun 1.3.14 and `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, then
`bun run dev`. Frontend 11029 proxies to backend 11028. The standalone CLI HTTP
default is 11027. `--mode dual` is an HTTP alias, not two listeners. Use `/mcp`
for MCP and `/api/health` for the optional REST health helper.

## Select a tool

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| inkscape_file | File load/validation, metadata, export/conversion |
| inkscape_vector | Construct SVG, path operations, queries, previews |
| inkscape_analysis | Inspect a file's objects, structure, dimensions, statistics |
| inkscape_render | Preview PNGs and multi-DPI exports |
| inkscape_validation | SVG quality, viewBox, size, pack checks |
| inkscape_system | Diagnostics, installed actions, native desktop/session operations |
| inkscape_fleet | External application handoffs and staging |
| inkscape_fab_art | Fabrication and robotics asset workflows |
| inkscape_sim_art | UI/icon sheets and simulation asset workflows |
| list_local_models | Discover local Ollama/LM Studio models |
| llm_ops | Manage local model engines and resident models |
| generate_heraldry | Fixed heraldic preset; custom operation is unimplemented |
| generate_svg | Generate and save SVG using client sampling |
| agentic_inkscape_workflow | Sampling-assisted workflow plan |
| intelligent_vector_processing | Sampling-assisted document processing plan |
| conversational_inkscape_assistant | Sampling-assisted vector graphics guidance |

Some enumerated vector operations remain incomplete: consult the limits in
TOOLS.md. In particular, the legacy QR helper is a text placeholder, not a
scannable encoder; mesh-gradient construction is unimplemented. Layer/animation
Python and REST helpers are not standalone tools in the main MCP registration.

## File workflows

Use absolute paths. `construct_svg` accepts complete SVG XML in `svg_content` and
an explicit `output_path`; no model service or sampling is required. An alternate
`params` object accepts `body` and optional `header`/`footer`.

File edits use supplied input/output paths. `inkscape_file` / `save` does not save
the unsaved desktop window. Managed exports stage and validate results before
replacing destinations. Check `success`, `message`, and output metadata before
proceeding. Unknown actions and missing IDs can fail even if native exit code is 0.

## Live workflows

All operations below use `inkscape_system`:

1. `install_live_extension`: explicit install into the target user's Inkscape
   profile. Restart windows opened before installation; inspect `needs_restart`.
2. `list_documents`: list live sessions. `desktop` identifies the ordinary
   Inkscape instance and requires exactly one window there.
3. `new_document(output_path)` creates an 800×600 SVG at a new path and launches
   its own instance; `open_document(input_path)` opens an existing SVG. Retain the
   returned `session_id`; reopening the same live managed path reuses its session.
4. `active_document(session_id)` reads unsaved SVG and object details.
5. `insert_svg(session_id, svg_content)` uses the native undoable effect;
   `draw_test(session_id, text)` inserts a blue rounded rectangle and editable text.
6. Confirm `data.verified` and object IDs after insertion. The effect appends a
   nested SVG with its coordinates/viewBox. Use fresh IDs or omit them; collisions
   are rejected. No clipboard helper is required.
7. `save_document(session_id)` saves a managed drawing to its original path and
   verifies disk content. `save_copy(session_id, output_path)` exports a verified
   snapshot without changing the GUI filename; it also works for `desktop`.
8. `close_document(session_id)` requests a managed document's normal close. An
   unsaved-changes dialog keeps it open; the server does not choose Discard.

Always use the returned session ID to target one of several documents. Unknown,
closed, or ambiguous targets do not fall back to another drawing. If an edit times
out or cannot be verified, inspect the target before retrying: it may already
have been applied. Preserve user edits and avoid duplicate insertion.

`list_actions(search, limit, offset)` discovers the installed CLI catalog with
bounded pagination. Catalog presence is not a guarantee of headless or D-Bus
availability. `hands_in_command(action)` dispatches normal native actions;
`active-window-start` and `active-window-end` are internal and rejected.

## Sampling and optional providers

Sampling tools require client support for `sampling.tools`; Context is injected.
Workflow tools return plans, which must be executed with the real editing tools.
The dashboard's Ollama/cloud path is separately configured. Ordinary editing,
construction, inspection, and export work without either model path.

## Configuration and provenance

Use `--config` for explicit YAML. `INKSCAPE_PATH` supplies executable discovery;
`MCP_TRANSPORT`, `MCP_HOST`, and `MCP_PORT` control transport. See
[Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) for defaults and file restrictions.
The main CLI does not automatically load arbitrary `.env` files; supply exported
variables or the client's environment settings.

Managed state lives under `~/.cache/inkscape-mcp/` by default (`XDG_CACHE_HOME`
can override it). Extension installation uses the Inkscape profile selected by
`INKSCAPE_PROFILE_DIR` or the XDG config location. Do not edit active exchange
files. Desktop access requires the same user's display and session D-Bus services.

This repository continues sandraschi/inkscape-mcp and adapts native effect work
from aravindev/inkscape_mcp. See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) and
[Upstream integration](docs/UPSTREAM_INTEGRATION.md) for exact provenance.
